responsibility: Declares the Debug module interface, exporting the routines used to emit debug strings and structured fatal diagnostics from other GNU Modula-2 boot runtime modules. The header defines the API boundary for lightweight debugging output, distinct from general-purpose string I/O and from the richer runtime exception interfaces.
same_name_distinction: This header only publishes the Debug_Halt and Debug_DebugString entry points for other modules. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GDebug.cc, it does not perform message formatting, escape handling, output, or termination.
